analysis.limitations: Fixed exploratory development cases only; no population FPR or calibrated bound. Native attack inverses and operating points differ. E3 q is original intended and h operational; v5 targets are historical original intended: no matched-target-basis ranking. None-mode delivery is separate from same-combined-call predicate ablations; v5 routing differences are not pure ablations. LPIPS subsets are exploratory proxies, without human admissibility. T5_same F measures suspect consistency; reference-specific same-owner attribution is unidentifiable in the source-blind API. Strict E3-B remains failed and M1a incomplete.

limitations: Twelve adaptively reused development sources; alpha-only construction; seen SD1.5 DDIM strengths/seeds and seen SDXL VAE. Safety-blocked rows remain unavailable. Reused calls are not independent replication. No population FPR, unseen-model generalization, incremental combined-binding benefit, cryptographic authorization or reference-specific same-owner attribution is established. Historical strict E3-B remains failed. This measured assessment does not advance official lifecycle gates.
